text: Jaya and her husband celebrating 10 years married on the 14th, doing a weekend in Lisbon. Text her that morning.
gemma engaged!! proposal on a beach in crete apparently. ring is her nan's
Deepa's manager is leaving end of the month and she's been asked to cover until they hire. Pretty stressed about it.

Call with Ilse re the Hamburg client. They want to renegotiate the whole contract and her director has basically left it to her. She flies out Thursday at 7am, meetings Friday morning and Monday, back sometime next week depending on how it goes. She sounded calm but admitted she hasn't done a negotiation this size before. Need to send her the updated deck before Wednesday evening and maybe call Sunday night to run through it.
Erin's wedding is off. She and Jakub split up last month, she's staying at her sister Matilda's for now. Check in with her over the weekend.
Ellie hates long flights, takes a sleeping pill and still doesn't sleep. Off to Sydney early March for three weeks to see her brother Gabriel.
Hassan, new guy on the accounts team. Supports Leeds, vegetarian, has a cat called Biscuit.

So I was chatting to Siobhan after the stand-up and she mentioned her and Patrick's anniversary is coming up, it's their 25th, silver, and the kids are throwing them a surprise party at a pub in Galway on Saturday the 7th at 8pm. Her daughter Alina is organising it all. Siobhan's not supposed to know but obviously does. I said I'd chip in for the present, so remind me to transfer Alina some money by Friday.
naledi back from cape town. said the flight home was 13 hrs + a delay in doha. jet lag awful
Anan's review with his boss is Monday at 10. He thinks he might get the senior role. Ask him how it went Monday night.
Book the dentist. Renew passport before the summer.
Imani said she and Reza are finally doing a honeymoon, two weeks in Japan over the summer. Reza's never been on a plane longer than 4 hours lol
Gabriel mentioned his mum's 70th is the 22nd and they're all going to Porto for it. He's paying for her flights.
Matilda keeps hinting she wants a proper espresso machine for their anniversary, apparently Julien has no idea. Don't forget to tell him.
Catalina Fernández (Cat) - new client contact at the agency. Based in Madrid, prefers calls before lunch, really into padel.
Siddharth's interview at the bank is tomorrow at 2pm. He's so nervous, barely ate at lunch. Send him a good luck text in the morning.
Jen moving to Dublin with her partner end of the year for his job. Wants to find something remote.
Emil's stag do is in Kraków sometime in early March. Jakub is organising, I'm already in for the paintball bit.
Lunch w Sofia. Her boss Mr Lewis is retiring in December and she's been tipped to take over his clients. Doesn't want to jinx it.
Zhang flying back to Shanghai for his grandad's funeral, leaves tonight at 11. Gone about ten days. Check in with him next week sometime.
Hiroshi and his wife expecting their first in April! He's been working from home more since she's had bad morning sickness.
camila's leaving do is fri from 5 at the usual place. she's off to a startup in berlin. card going round, need to sign it before thursday
Julien said his parents' 40th wedding anniversary is next weekend, the whole family's going to Provence. His dad gets very emotional about these things apparently.
Ximena got the promotion! Team lead from the 1st. Must send congrats.
Aneesh and Deepa came back from Bali yesterday. Flight got cancelled in Singapore so they had an extra night there, which they didn't mind.

Nikolai's struggling a bit with the new manager, says she micromanages everything, reads every email he sends to clients and moved his one-to-ones to Friday at 5pm. He's been there six years and loved it until the restructure. Thinking about looking elsewhere, maybe even moving back to Riga to be near his parents. His wife Camila is supportive but they've just bought the flat. Lunch with him sometime next week to talk it through.
Patrick - fly fishing, Irish rugby, does a mean BBQ. Allergic to shellfish.
Note to self: client dinner Thursday at 7.30, Hassan and I are presenting the renewal numbers on Friday at 9.

Alina's sister Sofia got engaged in Paris on Saturday night! Her boyfriend Gabriel proposed at the top of Montmartre at sunset, had the ring in his coat pocket the whole trip and was terrified of losing it. Alina was in tears telling me, she's been hoping for this for years. Wedding's probably next summer, possibly in Italy where his family's from. Alina's already been asked to be maid of honour and is a bit overwhelmed by the idea of organising a hen.

Reza's dad has a hip op on the 3rd at half 8 in the morning. Reza is flying out to Tehran the day before to be there and staying a fortnight to help his mum. He's worried, his dad's 81 and had a bad reaction to anaesthetic last time. Message him on the 4th to see how it went, and cover his client calls while he's away.
Jaya's cat Pickle went missing while they were in Greece, neighbour was meant to be feeding her. Found her two days later in a shed, all fine.
Gemma Rossi - goes by Gem. Works in procurement at the client, two kids, big fan of musicals.

Okay voice note. Talked to Imani on the phone for ages tonight. Her brother Emil is getting married in Goa in January and the whole family's flying out for a week. She's worried about the cost and whether she can get the time off because her boss is already being funny about her holiday this year. She's going to ask him tomorrow morning. Need to ask her how that conversation went, maybe Thursday.
ellie's anniv w Hassan is tues. 5 yrs. she wants a weekend away, he's thinking Bruges
Deepa mentioned the client in Singapore wants someone out there for a month over the summer. She's tempted but her son Aneesh starts school in September.
Erin's first day at the new firm was Monday. Text her and see how the first week's gone.
Holiday plan: flights to Lima booked for the 18th at 6am. Still need travel insurance and a yellow fever jab, ideally sometime next week.
Matilda's grandma passed away on Sunday. Funeral is the 30th at 11 in Bristol. She seemed okay but quiet.
Got chatting to Anjali by the coffee machine. She's into bouldering and goes three times a week, wants to do a trip to Fontainebleau in the spring.
Jakub and his girlfriend Ilse were meant to be going to New York for her birthday but they've cancelled it, his work won't let him off. They're doing a cabin in Wales instead in early November.
Siobhan's son Julien just passed his driving test, first go. She's terrified about him having the car.
gabriel nervous about his best man speech for his brother's wedding on the 15th. offered to read a draft, he's sending it tmrw evening
Hiroshi's boss is Mrs Santos. Strict but fair, he says. She's off on maternity leave from the end of the month and nobody knows who's covering.
Need to remember: Camila's birthday is 9 November. She likes good gin and anything from Liberty.

Ximena's fiancé Nikolai is from Kyiv. Wedding's in Kyiv next June, then a party in London a couple of weeks later for everyone who can't travel. Already invited to both. She said the dress is being made by her aunt in Mexico City, and her mum is flying over in May to help. Need to sort flights by end of the month while they're cheap, and ask about the gift list.
Car MOT due early next month. Cancel gym membership.
Sofia's off to Iceland next Tuesday morning for the northern lights, it's been on her list forever. Ask for photos when she's back.
Zhang and his partner Jen celebrated their 3rd anniversary at that Korean place. He loved the recommendation.

Call w Patrick. The Moreau account is in trouble, the client's unhappy with timelines and their new CFO is threatening to put it out to tender. Big meeting Wednesday at 4pm, he wants me in it to talk about the delivery side. He's not sleeping well, his wife's away with work all week and he's got the two boys on his own. Prep slides tomorrow morning.
Alina is going to Morocco with her mum sometime in the spring, just the two of them. First proper holiday since her dad died.
Remind me to ring Uncle Siddharth about the wedding arrangements this weekend. Mum says he's upset about the seating plan.
Anan Shah's daughter Gemma is graduating from Edinburgh on the 2nd of July. He's flying up the night before, so proud.
Naledi mentioned her partner is a pilot with BA, mostly long haul. He's away about half the month.
dropping hints for anniversary: Jen wants the new Kindle, said it twice
Emil's back at work after his paternity leave. Baby Luna is 6 weeks. He looks shattered.

Hassan told me his parents are coming over from Lahore for a month over the summer, first time they'll meet his fiancée Deepa. He's a bit nervous about it, her family's quite traditional too. They're planning the engagement party around the 20th of August so both families can be there. Should get them something nice for that.
Catalina's team offsite is in Seville the week of the 10th. She said there's a flamenco night on the Thursday at 9.
Quiet day. Finished the expenses report, ordered euros for the trip.
Imani's Rossi pitch went really well yesterday, client signed this morning. Must remember to congratulate her properly at Friday drinks, half 5.
Anjali says her husband Reza has been offered a 6 month secondment in Toronto starting early January. They're still deciding whether she and the kids go too. Follow up with her in a few weeks.
